name_en: Saba no hakozushi — mackerel-topped pressed sushi from the Izu coast
summary_ja: ほぐしたサバのそぼろやにんじん、しいたけの煮物を酢飯にのせ、木箱に詰めて押しかためる。日蓮上人を匿った漁師が井桁の重箱で食事を運んだ故事に由来すると伝わる、伊豆地域のハレの日の押し寿司とされる。
summary_en: Flaked simmered mackerel, carrot, and shiitake are laid over vinegared rice packed into a wooden box and pressed. Local lore ties its origin to a fisherman who once carried meals in a lattice box to the exiled priest Nichiren — a festival-day pressed sushi of the Izu coast.
source_title: 鯖の箱寿司 静岡県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Gennari zushi — a large pressed sushi topped with seasoned golden eye snapper
summary_ja: 甘く煮たにんじんを詰めた酢飯を型に押し、キンメダイの紅白のそぼろをのせる押し寿司。結婚式や七五三などの祝い事でつくられ、その大きさに食べるだけで「げんなり」してしまうことが名の由来と伝わる。
summary_en: Vinegared rice packed with sweet-simmered carrot is pressed in a mold and topped with pink and white flaked golden eye snapper. Made for weddings and coming-of-age celebrations, its name is said to come from how filling — gennari, or wearying — just eating it could be.
source_title: げんなり寿司 静岡県｜うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
